item.title: API Testing Interview Questions
item.description:
Beginner (Basics & Concepts)

  1. Explain API?
  2. What is an API?
  3. What are the different types of API?
  4. What is the full form of J-SON?
  5. Explain CRUD operations?
  6. What are the main components of an HTTP request and response?
  7. What are common status codes you get in API testing?
  8. What is the difference between POST and PUT?
  9. What is the difference between PUT and PATCH?
  10. What is the difference between GET and POST?
  11. What is the difference between synchronous and asynchronous API calls?
  12. Explain idempotency in APIs? Why is it important?
  13. What is API versioning and why is it needed?
  14. What are query parameters and path parameters?

Questions with Answers

1. Explain API?

Answer: API stands for Application Programming Interface. It acts as a bridge that allows two software applications to communicate and share data with each other.
